attempts.raw: BYOK stands for Bring Your Own Key, which refers to the practice of using a private key to authenticate access to a service or system. In the context of a model-powered application, BYOK allows developers to manage their own keys and securely store them in a secure location, rather than relying on a central key management system. This can provide greater flexibility and control over access to the application, as well as the ability to manage key rotation and access policies.

Rank takes args rows (array of [name,[three numeric scores]]), a,b,c (numeric weights) and produces sorted weighted rows. No other functions, properties or nesting of components.
